name: Fox Summon Scroll
description:
A three-tailed fox.  Its resemblance to the legendary nine-tailed fox brings the misunderstanding that it is an uncanny beast.  To the contrary, however, three-tailed foxes are docile and friendly.  Despite what the sensuous looks may suggest, their attack is powerful and quick, hence being trained for hunting.

Redeem one package to a character. Its NFT is permanently locked and cannot be resold or withdrawn. The delivered items follow their native game rules. The summon item is reusable; this pet has no rental expiry. Recall and resummon do not consume it.
